Messages.Author: Reyda
Messages.Body:
Hi !
I take control of my predator's vampire with Spriti marionnette. This
vampire is untapped but with zero blood and a Pulled fangs on him =)
now the vamp must bleed but he cannot since he must hunt, but as he must
hunt, he goes to torpor without doing any action. Since i lose controle of
him only at the end of my next action (and the marionette didn't do
anything), can i use one my other vamp to play "Peace of Khetamon", thus
gaining permanently control of the torpored vampire and placing it in my
uncotrolled (!) region ?

reyda

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


You can Peace of Khetamon him, but doing so with move him to his
permanent controller's uncontrolled region, not your own.

--

controller's uncontrolled region.

Sacrifical Lamb can be played, by explicit card text.
